_about: Hand-written notes for docs/pr-index.md, keyed by PR number. scripts/pr-index.py fills in the number, title, state and date from GitHub, and for a PR with no entry here it uses the first sentence of its description, a guessed area and its most-changed files. Add or correct an entry to improve a line; the next run picks it up.

1.summary: First 8-track mixer: each track plays an audio file plus a MIDI file through its own instrument.

2.summary: Tracks become timelines of clips, with a file browser, bounce, reverse, clip editing and the Selector.

3.summary: Pop-out Analysis Meters window with Audition-level loudness, spectrum, phase and level meters.
3.where: Analyze or View menu, Analysis Meters (Ctrl+Alt+A)

4.summary: 8x8 pop-out patchbay over one routing graph for editor, samplers, synths, mixer tracks and FX buses.

5.summary: Drop audio files on the Analysis Meters window to get a full text statistics report for each.

6.summary: Directional panel focus, Ctrl+W closes what has focus, Simplest docked along the bottom, draggable Selector rows.

7.summary: Project files (.phi) that save the mix, patchbay and view, and reopen at the next start.
7.where: Mixer menu, New / Open / Save Project

8.summary: Ambisonic Studio: Envelop for Live's device set in a floating rack panel with a room view.

9.summary: Eight free bundled instruments (Granular, Retro Sampler, Cardinal and more), named by what they do.

10.summary: Record PHI to MP4 (H.265 + AAC) and stream it live, with cameras and multitrack sound.
10.where: Performance menu, Record Video (Ctrl+F12), Go Live (Shift+F12)

11.summary: Ambisonics visualizer card (orders 1 to 10) showing where the sound is in an ambisonic file.

12.summary: Record any PipeWire application's sound, such as a web browser, alongside PHI.
12.where: Performance, Video and Stream Settings, Sound

13.summary: Speaker layouts up to 9.1.6 and 7.1.8 and a per-channel view for the ambisonics visualizer.

14.summary: Tracker instruments can play through a slot of the Retro Sampler (Ami).

15.summary: Any web page as the background of the whole PHI window (optional, Qt WebEngine).

16.summary: Ableton-style clip launcher grid of tracks and scenes, fed from the Selector.

17.summary: Quantize panel with hitpoints, groove templates and more warp algorithms (Cubase and Live style).

18.summary: Two trackers: the built-in Tracker1 (MilkyTracker style) and Tracker2 (Furnace) with an opacity bar.

19.summary: Describe your own speaker arrays (up to 16 channels) for the ambisonic decoders; faster studio preview.

20.summary: Build fix: Cardinal's bundled libraries build one at a time so errors are readable.

21.summary: Panels open at a usable size on tiling window managers, and Alt works for panel navigation.

22.summary: Cardinal gets PHI-style knobs, jacks and Φ screws, and finds its resources when installed.

23.summary: Plugin windows tile, keep their view in place, and scale fixed-size editors to fit.

24.summary: CPU and audio-load meter in the status bar.
24.where: Status bar; View menu, CPU Meter

25.summary: Simplest and the Slicer open in their own windows, open empty, and load from Find with F7/F8.
25.where: F7 Simplest, F8 Slicer, Find panel

26.summary: Prisms: nested racks in the Device Chain that split into parallel, band, mid/side or left/right rays.
26.where: Device Chain, Add plugin, Built-in, Prism (Ctrl+G)

27.summary: Renames the app from PHINYX to PHI everywhere, with a Φ logo.

28.summary: Says why a stock instrument won't open, after looking for it again first.

29.summary: Nine golden-ratio Φ effects (EQ, Echo, Space, Drift and more) and a Φ switch for Stereoize and Mid/Side Width.

30.summary: Sonify: plays the Visualizer, pictures, videos, cameras or the web page as MIDI notes.

31.summary: Master Assistant tunes the Master Section's knobs toward a reference or a loudness target.

32.summary: Bundles Airwindows Consolidated (all 528 Airwindows effects) as a stock plugin in the PHI frame.

33.summary: Mix Assistant sets each track's fader and pan from the role it guesses for the track.

34.summary: Plugin views follow their frame, open at a standard size and follow PHI's opacity.

35.summary: Original Φ mark, golden splash, Φ windows, Φ random selector and an editable Φ EQ.
35.where: Splash, Help menu About, Selector Φ button, Φ EQ window

36.summary: A new phase distortion sound plays each time the Φ splash opens.

37.summary: Fixes PHI crashing on quit when Cardinal was loaded.

38.summary: Full mixer channel strip (inserts, sends, track modes, Duck) and 8-knob Device Chain cards with Dry/Wet.

39.summary: PHI Gold theme, gold on near-black, now the default.

40.summary: Mixer and launcher layout: Inspector, per-track Device Chain, clip view, fast MIDI edits, Selector-set tracks.

41.summary: Performance fix: no idle redraws, and loudness metering no longer grows with uptime.

42.summary: Φ Phaser, and the Φ DSP split out as a library (phi_dsp) the PHI synth can link.

43.summary: Φ Compressor, Φ Multiband, Φ Limiter and Φ Chorus built on golden ratios.

44.summary: Paulstretch extreme time stretching (Extreme Stretch) and an Ambient warp algorithm.

45.summary: Paulstretch on mixer clips, a Finder/Inspector column, fixed Device Chain and editor round trip.
45.where: Mixer, clip Inspector, Audio Clip section

46.summary: The PHI manual, built as a web site and a PDF from Markdown chapters.

47.summary: Tuning (EDOs, scales, ragas, maqams) and MPE for the PHI synth, in phi_dsp.

48.summary: Plugin Doctor-style Plugin Analyzer, Forensic Φ and an aliasing scope.

49.summary: Modal tunings per clip, scene and track, and PHI rāga: raga sheets, a raga player and a sitar.
49.where: Mixer, MIDI Clip section and track tuning

50.summary: Species counterpoint generator (Fux's rules) against a MIDI clip, in any modal tuning.

51.summary: Recording into slots and onto the timeline, live looping, audio and MIDI layers, and a full transport.

52.summary: Control surfaces (Launchpad, Launchkey, Push 2/3) with no drivers, and MIDI Learn.

53.summary: The 100 rare rāgs of Ghulām Ḥaidar's Sau Achhūp Rāg, taking the raga sheets to 174.

54.summary: Indonesian gamelan laras and pathet (Javanese, Balinese, Sundanese) in measured cents.

55.summary: Shona mbira tunings from Zimbabwe in their own measured cents.

56.summary: Chinese, Japanese and Korean modes and historical tunings.

57.summary: Fugue generator: 2 to 4 voices on a clip's melody, each on a new track.

58.summary: Hypo (plagal) ranges for ragas, maqams and dastgahs.
58.where: Mixer, MIDI Clip section, mode range

59.summary: Accurate, lower-case transliterations for every non-European mode and raga name.
59.where: Mixer, MIDI Clip section, Mode or raga list

60.summary: Top-level Mode menu: pick one mode, final and range, and the rest of PHI uses it.

61.summary: Editor Track: one project track shown under the editor's waveform, with recording and editing.

62.summary: 117 rhythmic modes: tāls, tāḷams, breakbeats, trap, medieval modes and world rhythms.

63.summary: Stochasticize: Xenakis's ST clouds, sieves and Markov screens to write new lines from MIDI clips.
63.where: Mixer, MIDI Clip section and Mode menu, stochasticize
